definition: "Wilful killing" is a war crime as codified in the Rome Statute for the International Criminal Court. A prosecution for wilful killing must show the following elements:  A killing of one or more persons,  who were protected under the Geneva Conventions of 1949,  the perpetrator knew of the factual circumstances establishing that protection,  the conduct was associated with an international armed conflict. widow / wilful killing Dictionary compilation | 26 September 2026
